persona: Natural adult male technical instructor. Neutral American English. Calm, clear, confident, conversational. Medium-low pitch. Professional but friendly. An experienced Azure/Terraform engineer teaching a junior cloud engineer. NOT: commercial announcer, news presenter, movie trailer, overexcited YouTuber, AI-assistant voice, robotic TTS.

minimax.notes: OPTIONAL PAID PROVIDER — never required by the normal pipeline. Select voice_id once manually; voice consistency matters more than the provider. Needs MINIMAX_API_KEY; select explicitly with --provider minimax.

notes: Edge TTS (en-US-AndrewNeural) is the canonical course voice — same male narrator used by the proven terraform-azure-essentials production. FREE, no API key. Never switch voices between episodes. speed 0.88 (-12%) was chosen from measured legacy renders (~165 wpm at 1.0) to land inside the course pace bands (120-150 wpm; code explanations slower).
